name: Hayley Dunn
headline: First Year Student at Miami University
location: Belle Mead, New Jersey, United States

experiences.description: As a basketball coach, I coached younger children over the summer where I could get a sense of working with different types of people of all ages while also doing something I loved.

While working here, I took online orders, answered phone calls, greeted and said goodbye to customers, seated customers, took online reservations, packaged and processed online orders, sold gift cards,
occasionally brought out food to tables
As a receptionist, I answered phone calls, scheduled appointments, helped out around the salon, restocked and organised products, and did laundry which are all valuable skills to have when working.
